notes.title: PATCH Alpha v3.6
notes.notes:
Update v3.5

*Added 2 new planets to test the Waves mode on Normal and Hard (highlighted in blue when hovered).

*Added 2 new enemy type.  Stealth and Regenerative.  You may see these enemies on Normal or Hard missions.

*Decreased spawn rate across the board.  While easy mode has the lowest spawn timers, it does increase per difficulty level.

*Adjusted the speed of the RAT vehicle.

notes.title: PATCH Alpha v3.0
notes.notes:
After updating 1 Major and  a few key engine elements, I struggled with some back end bugs.  

*Once the bugs were worked out, I was able to continue relative development. Mainly some graphical and performance issues.  The game should run much more smooth on lower end machines with little to no problems.  

*I have begun working on a new map as well as the escape game-mode.  
You should see both in a patch around the first or second week of May 2019.

notes.title: PATCH Alpha v2.2
notes.notes:
[b]Patch: Alpha 2.2[/b]

[b]BALANCING:[/b]

[list]
[*] Adjusted the number of enemy airstrikes on an "easy" level.
[*] Increased starting credits amount.
[*] Increased starting research points.
[*] Decreased amount of research points for victory on “easy”;
[*] Slightly decreased Boss enemy health.
[*] Slightly decreased Command Center health.
[*]Adjusted the amount of credits, research points and salvaged inventory you are awarded at the end of each successful mission.
[/list]

[b]GUI:[/b]

[list]
[*]Tooltips are now available in game. Simply press the [TAB] key to activate them.  Nearly all noteworthy mission GUI elements are affected by this change.
[*]Modified some buttons in the tutorial section to better visualize separation of functionality.
[*]Added temporary icons to the end screen (Victory, Defeat) for quick reference on what you managed to salvage after the battle.
[*]Tower upgrade panel now correctly displays the amount of upgrades available.
[/list]

[b]BUG FIXES:[/b]

[list]
[*]Fixed a bug that required you to restart the game in order to create a new game. You are now able to create a new game more easily and as often as you'd like during Alpha development.
[*]Fixed a bug where, sometimes you would be unable to complete the level due to enemy count.
[/list]

notes.title: PATCH Early Access
notes.notes:
Alpha v2.0

The time has come to share this with everyone!  Of course all feedback is welcome, but keep in mind that this game is in alpha and is in the process of solo development.  Expect regular updates, some bigger than others.  Regular updates about once or twice per week, and bigger updates once or twice per month.  Full release and completion should be mid 2019.

[i]Early Access Patch:[/i]

[b]COMMUNITY[/b]
[list]
[*] Implemented Early Access badges.
[*] Added 2 more badges to the build
[/list]

[b]GAMEPLAY[/b]
[list]
[*] Removed an older version of the tutorial.
[*] Added a newer and much quicker version of the tutorial.
[/list]


[b]SOUND[/b]
[list]
[*]  Added robotic voice over to the messaging area.
[*]  Normalized the voice over and added a volume slider.
[/list]

[b]VISUALS[/b]
[list]
[*]As you know, the game was not meant to have crazy detailed graphics, rather a exaggerated cartoon appeal. As I work toward delivering this concept, please note small changes now and again to brightness or contrast and shading. Most likely intended.. but who knows!
[/list]

[b]COMBAT[/b]
[list]
[*] Added slightly more speed to the rockets, both enemy and friendly.
[*] Increased timer delay for EMP rockets (these things are OP!)
[/list]

notes.title: PATCH Alpha v1.5
notes.notes:
[h1][b]WHATS NEW?[/b][/h1]

[u]DRONE[/u]

[list]
[*] Completely new overhaul of the "drones" HUD.  This is more in line with the futuristic appeal.

[*] Tweaked some of the controls to give the drone a little more responsiveness.

[*] Drone initiating sequence and visuals have been altered.

[*] The drone now overlays the battlefield with grid-lines to give you more of the augmented reality feel.
[/list]

[u]GAME-PLAY[/u]

[list]
[*] The enemy have peppered the field with gray smoke canisters to conceal their movement! You will now see a grayish haze or "Fog of War".  This is intentional for now, and in the process of developing better results. 

[*] A concept of a new enemy combatant (The Tunneler) has been in the works.  Tho the Tunneler is not yet implemented in to the game, the concept feature of tunneling is.  Your enemy will try to find weak spots in the terrain to achieve their final destination more quickly and quietly.  "This is where Radars will come in handy!"
[/list]

[u]TEMPORARY FEATURE[/u]

If you hit the escape key while in the "Company Overview" UI (Research, Inventory ect...) you will see a button that says "NEW GAME" in the popup menu.  By selecting this you will be restart the game as if it was your first time.. except you retain your stats and achievements of course.  This is helpful for bug fixes or just resetting the game so that you can truly play around while its in development.
